changelog: SchoolApp v2.1.2 — CBT class-assignment fix. Exams no longer go missing for a class: class values are resolved to one real class (code, label, legacy bare numbers such as “1”, and classes that were renamed or deleted), so an approved paper reaches every student in that class and the visibility check reports the real population instead of “nobody is assigned”. Includes one-click repairs on the Visibility page (move an exam onto a real class, move students with an unrecognised class into a class), blocks deleting a class that students or exams still use, and stores the canonical class code on new exams and student records. Web portal and the mobile API now share the same rules.
database_queries: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `sm_cron_logs` (`id` INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, `job_key` VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, `job_name` VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, `trigger_source` VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cli', `status` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running', `exit_code` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `started_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `finished_at` DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, `duration_ms` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `output` LONGTEXT NULL, INDEX `idx_cron_job` (`job_key`), INDEX `idx_cron_started` (`started_at`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
